label: Stress probability
description: Out-of-fold P(deficit) from a leave-one-plant-out logistic model on all sensors' baseline-delta traits.

label: Stress probability (fusion model)
description: Out-of-fold P(deficit) from the fusion model on DOFA / ImageBind embeddings of all sensors present; 5 folds grouped by plant.

label: Severity stage (fusion model)
description: Expected stage 0-3 from the ordinal head (S0 healthy to S3 severe), out of fold.

label: Turgor deviation (fusion model)
description: Predicted leaf-clip shift from the turgor head, out of fold.

label: Stress probability (fusion model, external plants)
description: Mean P(deficit) of the 5 fold models on plants outside the training set (external test).

label: Severity stage (fusion model, external plants)
description: Expected stage 0-3 from the ordinal head, mean of the 5 fold models, external plants.

label: Turgor deviation (fusion model, external plants)
description: Predicted leaf-clip shift from the turgor head, mean of the 5 fold models, external plants.

label: Stress probability (fusion v2)
description: Out-of-fold P(deficit) from fusion v2: each sensor's change from the plant's baseline and from the control plants in the same run, plus the hand-made thermal features; 5 folds grouped by plant.

label: Severity stage (fusion v2)
description: Expected stage 0-3 from fusion v2's ordinal head (S0 healthy to S3 severe), out of fold.

label: Turgor deviation (fusion v2)
description: Predicted leaf-clip shift from fusion v2's turgor head, out of fold.

label: Held-out plant (fusion v2)
description: True on the 45 lock-box plants: no fold trained on them, so their fusion v2 scores are the mean of the 5 fold models (python -m uiwue.fusion.predict --lockbox). False: out of fold, development plants.
